import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

runtime = Path("src/do_again/browser/runtime.py")
tests = Path("tests/test_browser.py")

text = runtime.read_text()

start = text.index("def send_message(")
end = text.index("\n\ndef browser_self_test", start)
send_block = text[start:end]

send_block = send_block.replace(
'''def send_message(
    target: cdp.Target,
    text: str,
    *,
    timeout: float = 180.0,
) -> dict[str, Any]:''',
'''def send_message(
    target: cdp.Target,
    text: str,
    *,
    timeout: float = 180.0,
    wait_for_response: bool = True,
) -> dict[str, Any]:'''
)

anchor = '''    if not accepted:
        if cdp.evaluate(target, click, timeout=10.0, user_gesture=True) != "clicked":
            raise BrowserError("ChatGPT did not accept the submitted prompt")

    deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
'''
replacement = '''    if not accepted:
        if cdp.evaluate(target, click, timeout=10.0, user_gesture=True) != "clicked":
            raise BrowserError("ChatGPT did not accept the submitted prompt")

    if not wait_for_response:
        return {
            "response": "submitted",
            "chat_url": target.url,
        }

    deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
'''
if anchor not in send_block:
    raise SystemExit("acceptance anchor not found")
send_block = send_block.replace(anchor, replacement, 1)
text = text[:start] + send_block + text[end:]

notify_start = text.index("@_project_operation\ndef notify_receipt")
notify_end = len(text)
for marker in ["\n\n@_project_operation", "\n\ndef "]:
    idx = text.find(marker, notify_start + 10)
    if idx != -1:
        notify_end = min(notify_end, idx)
notify_block = text[notify_start:notify_end]
count = notify_block.count("return send_message(target, message, timeout=180.0)")
if count != 2:
    raise SystemExit(f"expected 2 notify sends, found {count}")
notify_block = notify_block.replace(
    "return send_message(target, message, timeout=180.0)",
    "return send_message(target, message, timeout=180.0, wait_for_response=False)"
)
text = text[:notify_start] + notify_block + text[notify_end:]
runtime.write_text(text)

test_text = tests.read_text()

test_text = test_text.replace(
'''            sent = send_mock.call_args.args[1]
            self.assertIn("DO_AGAIN_RECEIPT_READY", sent)
            self.assertIn("req-1", sent)
''',
'''            sent = send_mock.call_args.args[1]
            self.assertIn("DO_AGAIN_RECEIPT_READY", sent)
            self.assertIn("req-1", sent)
            self.assertFalse(send_mock.call_args.kwargs["wait_for_response"])
''',
1)

test_text = test_text.replace(
'''            rollover_mock.assert_called_once()
            self.assertEqual(send_mock.call_args.args[0], new_target)
            self.assertEqual(value["chat_url"], "https://chatgpt.com/c/new")
''',
'''            rollover_mock.assert_called_once()
            self.assertEqual(send_mock.call_args.args[0], new_target)
            self.assertFalse(send_mock.call_args.kwargs["wait_for_response"])
            self.assertEqual(value["chat_url"], "https://chatgpt.com/c/new")
''',
1)

anchor_test = '''    def test_duplicate_receipt_marker_is_not_sent_twice(self) -> None:
'''
new_test = '''    def test_send_message_can_return_after_submission(self) -> None:
        target = cdp.Target(
            "target",
            "https://chatgpt.com/c/project",
            "",
            "ws://127.0.0.1/x",
        )
        with (
            patch("do_again.browser.runtime._assistant_snapshot", return_value={"busy": False, "count": 0}),
            patch("do_again.browser.runtime._context_limit_warning", return_value=""),
            patch("do_again.browser.runtime.cdp.evaluate", side_effect=["ready", True]),
            patch("do_again.browser.runtime.cdp.insert_text"),
            patch("do_again.browser.runtime.cdp.press_enter"),
            patch("do_again.browser.runtime.time.sleep"),
        ):
            value = send_message(target, "hello", wait_for_response=False)
        self.assertEqual(value["response"], "submitted")
        self.assertEqual(value["chat_url"], target.url)

''' + anchor_test
if anchor_test not in test_text:
    raise SystemExit("test insertion anchor not found")
test_text = test_text.replace(anchor_test, new_test, 1)
tests.write_text(test_text)

subprocess.run(["python3", "-m", "unittest", "tests.test_browser"], check=True)
subprocess.run(["python3", "-m", "unittest", "discover", "-s", "tests", "-p", "test_*.py"], check=True)
subprocess.run(["git", "add", str(runtime), str(tests)], check=True)
subprocess.run(["git", "commit", "-m", "Complete receipt delivery on accepted submission"], check=True)
subprocess.run(["git", "push", "origin", "main"], check=True)
print(subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip())
